class.name: OpenXRExtPlaneDetectionExtension
class.experimental: Marked as experimental due to lack of community validation on devices such as the Magic Leap.

method.name: is_plane_detection_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if plane detection is supported; otherwise, [code]false[/code].

signal.name: updating_plane_detectors
signal.description: Emitted on every valid XR frame so that [OpenXRExtPlaneDetector] instances can update their state based on the time elapsed since the last frame.
